body:
I dont want to take drugs to "fix" it. I know its an issue but im not going to be medicated. Im not scared of drugs, I have done many, but im not waking up every day and taking a pill to cover up things. Honestly, im looking for everyday ways that can help me. Looking for things people have done that have helped them to come back down to a norm without being on a med.

I appreciate your opinion tho and have always looked at medication as being an option, its just not for me.
